_comment: Plane CE True All-In-One for Pterodactyl — Plane + PostgreSQL + Redis + RabbitMQ + MinIO in one server.
name: Plane CE - True All-In-One
author: reiniervg
description: LOW-CONFIG TRUE ALL-IN-ONE. Runs Plane Community Edition plus PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO inside ONE Pterodactyl server/container. No external services are required. ptero5 also creates a runtime NSS identity for the numeric UID/GID assigned by Pterodactyl Wings, allowing PostgreSQL initdb to run without root.

config.startup: {"done": ["success: api entered RUNNING state", "success: proxy entered RUNNING state", "Plane CE - Pterodactyl True All-In-One"]}

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu

mkdir -p                   /mnt/server/logs/access                   /mnt/server/logs/error                   /mnt/server/logs/backend                   /mnt/server/logs/services                   /mnt/server/data                   /mnt/server/.config                   /mnt/server/.local/share                   /mnt/server/services/postgres/data                   /mnt/server/services/postgres/run                   /mnt/server/services/redis                   /mnt/server/services/rabbitmq/data                   /mnt/server/services/rabbitmq/log                   /mnt/server/services/rabbitmq/home                   /mnt/server/services/rabbitmq/plugins                   /mnt/server/services/minio/data/uploads

cat > /mnt/server/README-PLANE-AIO.txt <<'EOF'
Plane CE - True All-In-One Pterodactyl

This ONE Pterodactyl server contains:
  - Plane application stack
  - PostgreSQL (internal 127.0.0.1:5432)
  - Redis (internal 127.0.0.1:6379)
  - RabbitMQ (internal 127.0.0.1:5672)
  - MinIO (internal 127.0.0.1:9000)

You DO NOT need to create separate Pterodactyl database/services.

Public service:
  - Only the primary Pterodactyl allocation, e.g. 30080/TCP

Persistent locations:
  - services/postgres
  - services/redis
  - services/rabbitmq
  - services/minio
  - plane.env
  - .plane-internal-secrets
  - logs/

TLS:
  - Keep Plane internal HTTP.
  - Put Nginx/Certbot on the host in front of the primary allocation.
EOF

echo "Plane True All-In-One directories created."

variables.name: Public Domain
variables.description: ONLY REQUIRED SETTING. Public hostname for Plane, without https://. Example: plane.district046.nl. Nginx/SSL will point this hostname to this server's primary allocation.

variables.name: Public Protocol
variables.description: Keep on https for production. Plane itself remains HTTP internally; Nginx on the Pterodactyl host terminates SSL.

variables.name: Upload Limit
variables.description: Maximum Plane upload size in bytes. Default 104857600 = 100 MiB.

variables.name: API Rate Limit
variables.description: Plane API rate limit. Safe default; normally leave unchanged.

variables.name: Authentication Rate Limit
variables.description: Anonymous authentication rate limit. Normally leave unchanged.
